qsm-ccr lead.description: Start an interactive Claude Code on a routed model (the provider's default, or <slug> from its allowlist) whose teammates route by name; ensures the router first

args.name: slug
args.description: an allowlist model slug; default: the catalog's default model

qsm-ccr sync.description: Make CCR's copy of codex's tokens and model list match codex's: refresh codex's catalog, copy the tokens, set the allowlist, reload the router only when a field changed

args.name: ifStale
args.description: do nothing when the last successful sync is under 24 hours old

args.name: detach
args.description: run the sync in a detached qsm-ccr process and return at once; its outcome is appended to sync.log in the state directory

qsm-ccr doctor.description: Report every seam (tools, CCR profiles and providers, user settings, teammate command, codex config, tokens, allowlist drift, last sync, daemon) without starting or writing anything
